topic: clean and condition a leather belt
core_question: How do I clean grime off a leather belt and keep it from cracking? (secondary: My device says connected to wifi but I have no internet access, what do I do?)
answer_summary: Wipe the belt down with a saddle soap-dampened cloth to lift dirt and oils, let it dry, then work in a leather conditioner such as mink oil to keep the leather supple and prevent cracking.; after the topic shift: Unplug both the modem and router from power for about 30 seconds, plug the modem back in first and wait for it to reconnect, then plug the router back in.
